oracle.name: Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk
oracle.scope: Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk 9.0.0.0 DataContractSerializer decode and re-serialisation of 29 recorded SOAP values, each in direct and renamed prefix form, in two SDK processes. Establishes these value projections only; not native Dataverse dispatch, organization service behaviour, or the NuGet package signature (not verified). The serializer output is recorded as its XML infoset (namespace-resolved names, resolved xsi:type, no namespace declarations, insignificant whitespace dropped), not as bytes.
